title: An Enormous Molecular Gas Flow in the RX J0821+0752 Galaxy Cluster
question: How did the ~10^10 Msun molecular gas reservoir in the RXJ0821 BCG form, and how is it related to X-ray cavities and ICM sloshing?

data.sensitivity: RMS 0.5 and 1.1 mJy/beam in line-free channels

what.value: XCO = 1.05e20 cm-2 (K km/s)-1 and CO(3-2)/(1-0) flux ratio of 8

evidence.quote: Following V17, CO(3-2) line fluxes have been converted to molecular gas masses by assuming a CO (3-2)/(1-0) flux ratio of $8$.

what.value: Cluster mass profiles used for gravity in buoyancy time

evidence.quote: The acceleration under gravity is determined using the cluster mass profiles from (cite: Hogan17b).
The foreground hydrogen column density was fixed to the Galactic value of $N_H = 2.01\ensuremath{\times 10^{20}}\hbox{$\rm\; cm^{-2}\,$}$ (cite: Kalberla05).

recipe.goal: Reduce Chandra data and make X-ray image
recipe.method: Reprocess with ciao, clean flares with lc_clean, sum 0.5-7 keV events, remove point sources with wavdetect, blank-sky background
Deprojected spectra in eight annuli fit with phabs x apec; derive density, pressure, entropy, cooling time
key_parameters: min 2500 net counts per annulus; C-stat for projected, chi2 with 25 counts/bin for deprojected
assumptions: nH = ne/1.2; NH fixed to Galactic; Anders & Grevesse abundances

recipe.method: Ellipse fit to depression; E=4pV; age from buoyant rise and sound crossing time
assumptions: line-of-sight size sqrt(ab); pressure balance with surroundings

recipe.method: Add mkcflow component within r_cool=50 kpc, Tmin 0.1 keV
Fit up to two Gaussians per pixel (beam-size averaging), 3 sigma detection, Monte Carlo significance test
Mmol from CO(1-0) flux with sub-Galactic XCO; CO(3-2) scaled by ratio 8
Box fluxes grown until S/N 1.5 in regions A and B

evidence.quote: the molecular gas mass is $(1.07\pm0.02)\ensuremath{\times 10^{10}}\hbox{$\rm\thinspace M_{\odot}$}$.
The best-fitting mass deposition rate is $\dot{M}_{\rm cool} = 34\pm10\hbox{$\hbox{$\rm\thinspace M_{\odot}$}\rm\; yr^{-1}\,$}$
we adopt a systemic redshift of $z=0.11087\pm0.00004$
A total of $2.4\ensuremath{\times 10^{8}}\hbox{$\rm\thinspace M_{\odot}$}$ of hot gas has been displaced in inflating the X-ray cavity.

not_stated_but_needed: Channels used for continuum fitting in uvcontsub
clean threshold, mask, cell and image size
Pixel-fit Gaussian priors/initial guesses and Monte Carlo procedure details
score_reason: Public data and many formulas given, but imaging parameters and fitting details are sparse or inherited.
rediscovery_reason: Public data and clear numeric targets (gas mass, fluxes) though imaging details missing.
